name: gh-issue-skills
description: GitHub issue and discussion lifecycle skills — read, create, implement, run directive protocols, author and promote Discussions

plugins.name: gh-issue
plugins.description: Drive one GitHub issue or discussion through its whole lifecycle: read it verbatim, save a chat as a classified issue, implement it with a test baseline that never touches pre-existing failures, execute the 8-section protocol a directive issue embeds, and author or promote an RFC-shaped Discussion
